pr_title: [Config] Fix QWEN3_235B PD config missing params

antipattern.code:
# ===== Node1（L100-L120 区域，produce 端） =====
Node1:
  device_ids: "[0:15]"
  role: "produce"
  nnodes: 1
  nproc_per_node: 16
  # ... 省略其他配置 ...
  kv_connector_extra_config:
    "device_ids": "[16:19]"
    "mooncake_protocol": "rdma"
    # ↑ 无 "use_ascend_direct": true → 默认 false，走普通传输通路

# ===== Node2（L140-L160 区域，consume 端） =====
Node2:
  device_ids: "[0:15]"
  role: "consume"
  nnodes: 1
  nproc_per_node: 16
  # ... 省略其他配置 ...
  kv_connector_extra_config:
    "device_ids": "[16:19]"
    "mooncake_protocol": "rdma"
    "use_ascend_direct": true,   # 已配置正确
